description: Hand-authored classification of every runtime export of the pinned vue package (and every compile-time macro declared in its type declarations) into exactly one design.md row. Values are a row ID (status = the row primary status) or {row, status?, note?, needsDecision?}. An explicit status must be a status of the row, or X/E (stricter). Exports absent from this map fall back to X with note "unclassified: default-deny". compilerHelperExclusions lists compiler helper-table names that are vue exports and are not compilerInternal, each with a reason. A helper is compilerInternal when it is a vue export with status X, is emitted by the official compiler (helper tables of compiler-core, compiler-dom and compiler-sfc with an emission site), and has no exclusion.

interopArtifacts.__esModule: CJS interop marker that Node adds to the ESM namespace of a require()d CJS module. Not a Vue export: absent from require('vue') keys.
interopArtifacts.module.exports: Node CJS namespace export name that exposes the raw module.exports object. Not a Vue export: absent from require('vue') keys.

BaseTransition.note: Low-level base of Transition; only Transition (U23) is promised. Emitted only for a user-written <BaseTransition> tag, which the profile rejects.

DeprecationTypes.note: Compat-build enum. design.md makes no promise for the compat build, so it is unsupported by default.

ReactiveEffect.note: Low-level effect class; watchEffect (V13) is the promised surface.

compatUtils.note: Compat-build utility. design.md makes no promise for the compat build, so it is unsupported by default.

compile.note: Runtime template compiler. A08 and design.md: no runtime template compiler; compile-time configuration only.

devtools.note: Devtools hook object (plumbing). Devtools support is a build-time profile control (A17), not this export.

effect.note: Low-level effect primitive; watchEffect (V13) is the promised surface.

getCurrentWatcher.note: Returns the active watcher; not in the promised surface.

handleError.note: Internal error dispatch helper; A06 errorHandler is the promised hook.

hydrateOnIdle.note: Lazy-hydration strategy for SSR. X is the conservative default; W (A14/A16) would make it supported on web. Coordinator to confirm.

hydrateOnInteraction.note: Lazy-hydration strategy for SSR. X is the conservative default; W (A14/A16) would make it supported on web. Coordinator to confirm.

hydrateOnMediaQuery.note: Lazy-hydration strategy for SSR. X is the conservative default; W (A14/A16) would make it supported on web. Coordinator to confirm.

hydrateOnVisible.note: Lazy-hydration strategy for SSR. X is the conservative default; W (A14/A16) would make it supported on web. Coordinator to confirm.

initCustomFormatter.note: Devtools formatter plumbing. Devtools support is a build-time profile control (A17), not this export.

proxyRefs.note: Internal template-unwrapping proxy; isRef/unref (V07) are the promised surface.

queuePostFlushCb.note: Internal scheduler queue; nextTick (V17) is the promised surface.

registerRuntimeCompiler.note: Runtime template compiler registration. A08 and design.md: no runtime template compiler.

resolveFilter.note: Deprecated Vue 2 filter helper. Emitted only for the removed | filter syntax; the profile rejects filter syntax, so this name is not compilerInternal.

setDevtoolsHook.note: Devtools hook installer (plumbing). Devtools support is a build-time profile control (A17), not this export.

stop.note: Raw effect stop; watch handles (V15) are the promised surface.

useCssModule.note: CSS contract, design 9.2 (SFC scoping: CSS modules class maps). @vue/compiler-sfc 3.5.43 has no reference to useCssModule, so it is not compilerInternal.

useCssVars.note: CSS contract, design 9.2 (SFC scoping: useCssVars / CSS v-bind expressions). useCssVars is emitted by the SFC compiler for v-bind() in <style>.

warn.note: Internal warning emitter; the A06 warnHandler is the promised hook.

ArrayBuffer.note: ECMAScript global (L18); not a vue export.

AsyncDisposable.note: Resource-management protocol type/global (S24: X); not a vue export.

BigInt.note: ECMAScript global (L08: BigInt X); not a vue export.

CommonJS.note: Module-format name (L16: CommonJS X); not an API.

DataView.note: ECMAScript global (L18: DataView X); not a vue export.

NaN.note: ECMAScript numeric value (L07, L08); not a vue export.

RegExp.note: ECMAScript global (L18: broad parity E); not a vue export.

SameValueZero.note: ECMAScript key-equality operation used by Map/Set (L11); not a vue export.

ToBoolean.note: ECMAScript coercion operation (L07); not a vue export.

ToNumber.note: ECMAScript coercion operation (L07); not a vue export.

ToString.note: ECMAScript coercion operation (L07); not a vue export.

TypeScript.note: Language name used in S21/S24 text; not an API.

Uint8Array.note: ECMAScript typed array (L18: Uint8Array for IO with bounds); not a vue export.

WeakMap.note: ECMAScript global (L11: X initially); not a vue export.

WeakRef.note: ECMAScript global (L11: X initially); not a vue export.

WeakSet.note: ECMAScript global (L11: X initially); not a vue export.

inheritAttrs.note: Component option (U13; S11 defineOptions); not a module export.

onCleanup.note: Parameter of watch and watchEffect callbacks (V16); not a module export.

compilerHelperExclusions.BaseTransition: Emitted only for a user-written <BaseTransition> tag (compiler-core tag map). The profile rejects that tag (U23 promises Transition only), so generated code must not import it.
compilerHelperExclusions.Suspense: Emitted only for a user-written <Suspense> tag. Suspense is E (U25) and rejected by the production profile, so generated code must not import it.
compilerHelperExclusions.KeepAlive: Emitted only for a user-written <KeepAlive> tag. Public component (U21, P): user code may use it directly, so no internal flag.
compilerHelperExclusions.Teleport: Emitted only for a user-written <Teleport> tag. Public component (U22, A): user code may use it directly, so no internal flag.
compilerHelperExclusions.Transition: Emitted only for a user-written <Transition> tag (compiler-dom). Public component (U23, A): no internal flag.
compilerHelperExclusions.TransitionGroup: Emitted only for a user-written <TransitionGroup> tag (compiler-dom). Public component (U24, A): no internal flag.
compilerHelperExclusions.resolveFilter: Emitted only for the removed | filter syntax (compiler-core wrapFilter, COMPILER_FILTERS). The profile rejects filter syntax (no filter API in design.md), so generated code never imports it.
compilerHelperExclusions.capitalize: Helper-map entry with no emission site in @vue/compiler-core 3.5.43 (only the map and the export reference it).
compilerHelperExclusions.pushScopeId: Helper-map entry with no emission site in @vue/compiler-core 3.5.43 (only the map and the export reference it).
compilerHelperExclusions.popScopeId: Helper-map entry with no emission site in @vue/compiler-core 3.5.43 (only the map and the export reference it).
compilerHelperExclusions.unref: Public reactivity helper (V07, P): supported for user code. The compiler also emits it for setup refs, so no internal flag.
compilerHelperExclusions.isRef: Public reactivity helper (V07, P): supported for user code. The compiler also emits it, so no internal flag.
compilerHelperExclusions.defineComponent: Public API (A10, P): supported for user code. Emitted as the default export of script setup, so no internal flag.
compilerHelperExclusions.useModel: Public API (V26, P): supported for user code. Emitted by defineModel, so no internal flag.
compilerHelperExclusions.useSlots: Public API (V25, P): supported for user code. Emitted when script setup calls defineSlots(), so no internal flag.
compilerHelperExclusions.useCssVars: Public CSS contract (design 9.2, P): supported for user code. Emitted for v-bind() in <style>, so no internal flag.
compilerHelperExclusions.withAsyncContext: Emitted for top-level await in script setup. Top-level await is E (S14) and rejected by the production profile, so generated code must not import it.
